p: Cause every man to go out: Not because he was ashamed of his kindred, but rather because he wanted to cover his brother's sin.
grieved: This example teaches that we must by all means comfort those who are truly ashamed and sorry for their sins.
God: Though God detests sin, yet he turns man's wickedness into his glory.
my mouth that speaketh unto you: That is, that I speak in your own language and have no interpreter.
good of the land of Egypt: The most plentiful ground.
fat of the land: The main fruits and conveniences.
fall not out by the way: Seeing he had remitted the fault done to him, he did not want them to accuse one another.
fainted: As one between hope and fear.
